name: oMLX Monitor
description: Live view of one or more oMLX servers (omlx.ai) on the panel: loaded models with memory, requests in flight with tokens per second, queue, throughput and cache totals, memory pressure, and one-tap load/unload. Talks to each server through its own API key.

options.label: Server 1 URL
options.help: The oMLX server, as in its Admin dashboard address without the /admin part.

options.label: Server 1 API key
options.help: The server's main API key (Admin → Settings). Used only from this Mac to read status; the main key also unlocks the admin data (per-model activity, memory pressure, load/unload). A sub key gives the basic status only.

options.label: Server 1 name
options.help: Shown on the tab; blank = the host name.

options.label: Show Load / Unload buttons
options.help: Unloading frees the model's memory at once; loading takes as long as the model takes. Both need the main API key.
